I2C.hw_state_machine_hang: Hardware I2C state machine can enter undefined state after failed transaction. HAL_I2C_Mem_Read timeout may trigger this.
I2C.clock_stretching_errata: Errata with clock stretching on some F103 revisions. Use DMA mode or software I2C for reliability.
I2C.workaround: Use software I2C (i2c_soft module) or enable DMA mode for HAL I2C transfers.

USART.OVER8_not_reliable: OVER8 (8x oversampling) mode is unreliable on some F103 revisions. Use default 16x oversampling.
USART.workaround: Keep OVER8=0 (default 16x oversampling) for reliable communication.

USB.needs_external_pullup: F103C8T6 USB requires external 1.5k pull-up resistor on D+ (PA12) to 3.3V. Not all Blue Pill boards have this.
USB.workaround: Add external 1.5k resistor between PA12 and 3.3V, or use a board variant with built-in pull-up.

CAN.sram_tight: CAN peripheral exists on F103C8T6 but 20KB SRAM is tight for CAN buffers (16 filters + FIFO).
CAN.workaround: Reduce filter banks, use single FIFO, keep payloads small.

DMA.fsmc_conflict: DMA and FSMC cannot access SRAM simultaneously on F103. Not an issue for F103C8T6 (no FSMC).
DMA.circular_mode_buffers: DMA circular mode buffers must be in a memory region accessible by the DMA controller (all SRAM is OK on F103C8T6).

Boot.boot0_boot1: BOOT0=0 boots from Flash. BOOT0=1+BOOT1=0 boots from system memory (UART1 bootloader). BOOT0=1+BOOT1=1 boots from SRAM.
Boot.flash_lock: After flashing via ST-Link, BOOT0 must be LOW (Flash boot) for the application to run.

Flash.erase_cycle_limit: Flash endurance: 10,000 erase cycles minimum. Flash is 64KB organized as 64 pages of 1KB each.
Flash.wait_states: At 72MHz, 2 wait states required (FLASH_ACR = 0x12). CubeMX handles this automatically.

ADC.max_clock: ADC clock max 14MHz. At 72MHz PCLK2, use ADCPRE=/6 (12MHz) or /8 (9MHz). CubeMX default is /6.
ADC.sample_time: Too-short sample time causes inaccurate readings. For high-impedance sources, use 55.5 or 71.5 cycles.

GPIO.5v_tolerant: PA8-PA15, PB, PC are 5V-tolerant. PA0-PA7 are NOT 5V-tolerant (analog inputs). Do not apply 5V to PA0-PA7.
